<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 内容页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 卡片渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="cardGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FFFFFF"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F8FAFC"/>
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 白色背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 顶部橙色装饰条 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="6" fill="#D97757"/>
    
    <!-- 页面标签 -->
    <text x="60" y="55" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="2">
        {{PAGE_LABEL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 页面标题（核心观点） -->
    <text x="60" y="100" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE}}
    </text>
    <text x="60" y="135" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE_LINE2}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 三列卡片布局 -->
    <!-- 卡片1 - 绿色（推荐/成功） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#10B981" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="130" cy="250" r="35" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="130" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#10B981">💡</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="90" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="90" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="90" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="130" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#10B981">{{CARD_1_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片2 - 蓝色（流程/架构） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="460" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="460" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#4A90D9" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="530" cy="250" r="35" fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="530" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#4A90D9">⚡</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="490" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="490" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="490" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="530" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4A90D9">{{CARD_2_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片3 - 橙色（关键洞察） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="860" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="860" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#D97757" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="930" cy="250" r="35" fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="930" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#D97757">⚙️</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="890" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="890" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="890" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="930" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#D97757">{{CARD_3_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 页码 -->
    <text x="640" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">
        {{PAGE_NUM}} / {{TOTAL_PAGES}}
    </text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 结束页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1A1A2E"/>
            <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#16213E"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0F0F1A"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 橙色渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="accentGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#E8956F"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 光晕效果 -->
        <radialGradient id="glowOrange" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0.2"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="glowBlue" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0.15"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 网格装饰线 -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.02" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="1280" y2="180"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="360" x2="1280" y2="360"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540"/>
        <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="320" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="640" y1="0" x2="640" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="960" y1="0" x2="960" y2="720"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 光晕效果 -->
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="200" rx="250" ry="180" fill="url(#glowBlue)"/>
    <ellipse cx="980" cy="500" rx="280" ry="200" fill="url(#glowOrange)"/>
    
    <!-- 神经网络连接装饰 -->
    <g stroke="#4A90D9" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
        <path d="M150,150 Q250,100 350,180"/>
        <path d="M350,180 Q420,250 380,320"/>
        <path d="M950,400 Q1050,350 1100,420"/>
        <path d="M1100,420 Q1150,500 1080,550"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 节点装饰 -->
    <g fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.5">
        <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="350" cy="180" r="7"/>
        <circle cx="380" cy="320" r="4"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.6">
        <circle cx="950" cy="400" r="6"/>
        <circle cx="1100" cy="420" r="8"/>
        <circle cx="1080" cy="550" r="5"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 感谢语标签 -->
    <text x="640" y="240" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="3">
        THANK YOU
    </text>
    
    <!-- 主感谢语 -->
    <text x="640" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="52" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">
        {{THANK_YOU}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 装饰分隔线 -->
    <rect x="540" y="350" width="200" height="3" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- 副标语 -->
    <text x="640" y="410" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">
        {{TAGLINE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 联系信息卡片 -->
    <rect x="440" y="460" width="400" height="120" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.05" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.1" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
    
    <text x="640" y="505" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">
        {{CONTACT_NAME}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">
        {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="560" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.6">
        {{CONTACT_URL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 底部分隔线 -->
    <rect x="60" y="640" width="1160" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
    
    <!-- 底部信息 -->
    <text x="60" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{DATE}}
    </text>
    <text x="1220" y="680" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{COPYRIGHT}}
    </text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 章节页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1A1A2E"/>
            <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#16213E"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0F0F1A"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 橙色渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="accentGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#E8956F"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 光晕 -->
        <radialGradient id="glowOrange" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0.25"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 网格装饰线 -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.03" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="1280" y2="180"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="360" x2="1280" y2="360"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540"/>
        <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="320" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="640" y1="0" x2="640" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="960" y1="0" x2="960" y2="720"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 光晕效果 -->
    <ellipse cx="640" cy="360" rx="400" ry="300" fill="url(#glowOrange)"/>
    
    <!-- 装饰圆形 -->
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="80" fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.05"/>
    <circle cx="1080" cy="520" r="100" fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.05"/>
    
    <!-- 章节编号背景 -->
    <text x="640" y="280" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="200" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.03">
        {{CHAPTER_NUM}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- SECTION 标签 -->
    <text x="640" y="290" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="4">
        SECTION {{CHAPTER_NUM}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 装饰线 -->
    <rect x="540" y="320" width="200" height="3" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- 章节标题 -->
    <text x="640" y="400" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="48" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">
        {{CHAPTER_TITLE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 章节描述 -->
    <text x="640" y="460" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">
        {{CHAPTER_DESC}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 底部装饰线 -->
    <rect x="60" y="650" width="1160" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
    
    <!-- 页码 -->
    <text x="640" y="690" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{PAGE_NUM}} / {{TOTAL_PAGES}}
    </text>

</svg>

    <!-- Arrow 1 -->
    <polygon points="270,230 295,220 295,240" fill="#64748B"/>

    <!-- Step 2: Routing Decision -->
    <rect x="310" y="180" width="200" height="100" fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.1" stroke="#D97757" stroke-width="2" rx="12"/>

    <polygon points="520,230 545,220 545,240" fill="#64748B"/>

# 01_cover

[Transition] Welcome. Today we'll examine a critical vulnerability in commercial LLM APIs — the ability for providers to covertly substitute cheaper models while charging premium prices.

The question at the heart of this research: Are you getting what you pay for? Commercial API providers advertise specific models — Llama-3-70B, Qwen2-72B — but the black-box nature of APIs means users have no guarantee the advertised model is actually being served.

This work shows that software-based detection is fundamentally unreliable under realistic adversarial conditions. And it presents hardware attestation — specifically Trusted Execution Environments — as the provably secure alternative.

Duration: 1 minute

# 02_substitution_problem

[Transition] Let's first understand why providers might substitute models and what forms these substitutions take.

The economic incentive is straightforward: if you can serve a cheaper model while charging for an expensive one, the margin is pure profit. The paper formalizes this as a hypothesis testing problem — can an auditor distinguish P_spec(y|x) from P_actual(y|x)?

Four primary substitution types exist. First: serving a smaller model — say an 8B parameter model instead of a 70B — reducing GPU costs by roughly 85%. Second: FP8 or INT8 quantization, where precision is reduced but performance stays within error bars — cutting costs 40-60%. Third: fine-tuned variant swaps, where different checkpoint versions are served. Fourth: entirely different model families, like serving Qwen when Llama is requested.

Each of these creates a detectable signal in principle, but as we'll see, detection is practically infeasible.

Duration: 2 minutes

# 03_quantization_benchmark

[Transition] Here's the core problem with detection: FP8 quantization barely affects benchmark scores.

This table shows five model families tested across MMLU, GSM8K, MATH, and GPQA Diamond. Look at Llama-3-70B: original 78.05 on MMLU, FP8 version 77.88 — a difference of 0.17, well within error bars. The same pattern holds across nearly all models and benchmarks.

Even where differences exist — look at Llama-3-8B on MATH: 20.65 vs 14.91 — you need statistical power to detect it, meaning large sample sizes and many queries.

The implication: if a provider substitutes an FP8-quantized model, the performance difference is often invisible without expensive, extensive testing.

Duration: 2 minutes

# 04_temperature_scaling

[Transition] Temperature scaling further complicates detection. Higher temperatures are sometimes used to increase response diversity, but they also obscure substitution signals.

The four-panel chart in figure_1.jpg shows benchmark accuracy versus temperature for all five models. At low temperature (0.2), there's clear separation between original and quantized models. But at temperature 1.0 or 2.0, performance degrades across the board, and the gap between original and substitute becomes noisy and inconsistent.

The statistical challenge: distinguishing a small performance difference amid high variance requires exponentially more queries. At higher temperatures, you're essentially looking for a signal in a very noisy room.

[Pause] This is why benchmark-based detection becomes economically infeasible — you need too many queries, too much compute, to get statistical confidence.

Duration: 2 minutes

# 05_log_prob_nondeterminism

[Transition] Now let's examine why log-probability fingerprinting fails entirely.

The intuition behind fingerprinting: if you run the same model locally, you know what log probabilities it should produce. A substituted model would produce different patterns, revealing the swap.

But figure_5.jpg shows the problem: the same Llama-3-8B model produces different log probabilities depending on the software framework — transformers 4.40 versus 4.50, vLLM 0.6.2 versus 0.8.2 — and the GPU hardware — A100 versus H100.

This production-level nondeterminism means an auditor cannot distinguish between a legitimate model on different infrastructure and an actual substitution. The variation is inherent to the inference pipeline, not indicative of model swapping.

[Pause] This defeats fingerprinting completely. You cannot build a reliable detector when the baseline itself is shifting.

Duration: 2 minutes

# 06_randomized_substitution

[Transition] Even if you could detect a pure substitution, providers have an even more powerful countermeasure: randomized routing.

The attack works simply: with probability p, serve the substitute model; with probability (1-p), serve the specified model. The mixed distribution is p times the substitute distribution plus (1-p) times the specified distribution.

As p approaches zero, the observed distribution converges to the specified model's distribution. At p=0.1, you might need 100,000 queries to detect the substitution. At p=0.01, it becomes practically infeasible — the query budget required exceeds any reasonable auditing budget.

The adversarial advantage is asymmetric: the provider controls p and can dynamically adjust it to stay below detection thresholds. The auditor cannot know p, cannot know when adjustment occurs, and faces exponentially increasing query requirements as p decreases.

[Pause] This is what "query-prohibitive" means in practice — not just expensive, but fundamentally beyond reach.

Duration: 2 minutes

# 07_software_methods_summary

[Transition] Let's summarize why all three software-only auditing approaches fail.

First: text-based statistical tests like Maximum Mean Discrepancy. Method: compare output distributions. Weakness: require impractically large query budgets, fail on subtle or randomized substitutions. Limitation: at low substitution rates, the mixed distribution looks like the target — you can't statistically distinguish them without enormous sample sizes.

Second: log-probability methods. Method: compare token-level log probabilities to a local reference. Weakness: production nondeterminism defeats fingerprinting. Limitation: you can't tell the difference between different infrastructure and actual substitution.

Third: adversarial countermeasures. Method: benchmark evasion and randomized routing. Weakness: makes all software detection query-prohibitive. Limitation: providers can detect known benchmarks and route them to the genuine model.

[Pause] The common flaw: these methods observe outputs, not execution. They infer from behavior what they cannot directly verify. And that's fundamentally insufficient against an adversarial provider.

Duration: 2 minutes

# 08_tee_solution

[Transition] The only reliable path forward is hardware-level attestation — specifically, Trusted Execution Environments.

TEEs provide three key properties. Provable: cryptographic attestation guarantees that correct model weights are loaded and correct inference code runs. The hardware creates an isolated enclave, measures the contents, and signs the attestation quote. Efficient: unlike zero-knowledge proofs, which are computationally prohibitive for large models, TEEs have modest performance overhead suitable for production deployment. Robust: no dependency on observing outputs or inference behavior, so it's resistant to the adversarial evasion we just described.

The practical deployment path is NVIDIA Confidential Computing on H100 GPUs. This is available today — not a future research problem, not a theoretical solution. Hardware-level security built into the GPU provides the attestation capability organizations need.

[Pause] If you're evaluating LLM API providers, TEE attestation is the question to ask. Not "can you show me your benchmarks?" but "can you prove cryptographically which model is running?"

Duration: 2 minutes

# 09_takeaways

[Transition] Let me summarize the five key findings.

One: model substitution is economically motivated and practically undetectable via software. The cost incentives are massive, and the detection difficulty is fundamental, not just a matter of better tests.

Two: FP8 quantization barely affects benchmarks — performance differences fall within error bars, making statistical detection require impractically large sample sizes.

Three: inference nondeterminism kills log-probability fingerprinting. Production variation across software versions and GPU hardware creates a moving baseline that cannot be used for reliable detection.

Four: randomized substitution defeats statistical approaches. As the substitution probability approaches zero, the observed distribution converges to the target — the query requirements become exponentially prohibitive.

Five: TEEs are the only viable path to verifiable LLM APIs today. Hardware attestation provides provable, efficient, robust model integrity. It's available now via NVIDIA confidential computing.

[Call to Action] The call to action for this community: advocate for hardware attestation adoption in commercial LLM APIs. Push for transparency. Demand cryptographic proof, not statistical inference.

Thank you.

Duration: 2 minutes

Duration: 1 minute

# 02_substitution_problem

[Transition] Let's first understand why providers might substitute models and what forms these substitutions take.

The economic incentive is straightforward: if you can serve a cheaper model while charging for an expensive one, the margin is pure profit. The paper formalizes this as a hypothesis testing problem — can an auditor distinguish P_spec(y|x) from P_actual(y|x)?

Four primary substitution types exist. First: serving a smaller model — say an 8B parameter model instead of a 70B — reducing GPU costs by roughly 85%. Second: FP8 or INT8 quantization, where precision is reduced but performance stays within error bars — cutting costs 40-60%. Third: fine-tuned variant swaps, where different checkpoint versions are served. Fourth: entirely different model families, like serving Qwen when Llama is requested.

Each of these creates a detectable signal in principle, but as we'll see, detection is practically infeasible.

Duration: 2 minutes

# 03_quantization_benchmark

[Transition] Here's the core problem with detection: FP8 quantization barely affects benchmark scores.

This table shows five model families tested across MMLU, GSM8K, MATH, and GPQA Diamond. Look at Llama-3-70B: original 78.05 on MMLU, FP8 version 77.88 — a difference of 0.17, well within error bars. The same pattern holds across nearly all models and benchmarks.

Even where differences exist — look at Llama-3-8B on MATH: 20.65 vs 14.91 — you need statistical power to detect it, meaning large sample sizes and many queries.

The implication: if a provider substitutes an FP8-quantized model, the performance difference is often invisible without expensive, extensive testing.

Duration: 2 minutes

# 04_temperature_scaling

[Transition] Temperature scaling further complicates detection. Higher temperatures are sometimes used to increase response diversity, but they also obscure substitution signals.

The four-panel chart in figure_1.jpg shows benchmark accuracy versus temperature for all five models. At low temperature (0.2), there's clear separation between original and quantized models. But at temperature 1.0 or 2.0, performance degrades across the board, and the gap between original and substitute becomes noisy and inconsistent.

The statistical challenge: distinguishing a small performance difference amid high variance requires exponentially more queries. At higher temperatures, you're essentially looking for a signal in a very noisy room.

[Pause] This is why benchmark-based detection becomes economically infeasible — you need too many queries, too much compute, to get statistical confidence.

[Transition] Now let's examine why log-probability fingerprinting fails entirely.

The intuition behind fingerprinting: if you run the same model locally, you know what log probabilities it should produce. A substituted model would produce different patterns, revealing the swap.

[Transition] Even if you could detect a pure substitution, providers have an even more powerful countermeasure: randomized routing.

The attack works simply: with probability p, serve the substitute model; with probability (1-p), serve the specified model. The mixed distribution is p times the substitute distribution plus (1-p) times the specified distribution.

As p approaches zero, the observed distribution converges to the specified model's distribution. At p=0.1, you might need 100,000 queries to detect the substitution. At p=0.01, it becomes practically infeasible — the query budget required exceeds any reasonable auditing budget.

[Pause] This is what "query-prohibitive" means in practice — not just expensive, but fundamentally beyond reach.
